title: GCLI-36a: code-map pure layer (estimateTokens, path and identifier extractors, diff parsers, range merge)
description: Child of GCLI-36 (12a), second split confirmed by the leader on 2026-11-17 because 12a alone is over the ~400-line ceiling. 12a-1 is the PURE layer of the tier 1, 2 and 4 parity port of opum-cli's deterministic code-map producer (opum-ai/opum-cli dev 91542f4, src/context/code-map.ts, read by ref only): no git, no command. Functions: estimateTokens exactly (Math.ceil(text.length / 4) over UTF-16 code units, per opum-cli dev 093b0e9 src/adapters/instruction-blocks.ts:122-124), pathsNamedIn, collectIdentifiers and distinctiveIdentifiers, parseNumstat, parseHunkRanges, range merge and format, isNonCodePath over NON_CODE_PREFIXES, and the caps as constants. Tested against the producer's own cases.

acceptanceCriteria.text: estimateTokens returns Math.ceil(text.length / 4) over UTF-16 code units, with a test that a non-BMP character counts as two units.

pathsNamedIn, collectIdentifiers, distinctiveIdentifiers, parseNumstat, parseHunkRanges, range merge and format and isNonCodePath behave as the deterministic producer at opum-cli dev 91542f4, each pinned by tests drawn from the producer rules, including the URL, absolute-path, dot-segment and prefix exclusions, the backticked-token filter, the path-suffix dedupe, binary numstat and pure-deletion hunks.
The module reads no git, runs no process and adds no dependency; the caps are exported constants equal to the producer caps; bun run check passes.
